apiKey.keyFor: Syncing to the Tencent IMA knowledge base needs your own Client ID and API Key

evidence.quote: 填入 **Client ID** 和 **API Key**（在 [ima.qq.com/agent-interface](https://ima.qq.com/agent-interface) 获取）
把 Zotero 中选中的文献附件一键同步到 **腾讯 IMA 知识库**

checkNote: The quick start tells users to enter a Client ID and API Key obtained from ima.qq.com, and the apiKey pref ships empty. The plugin only syncs attachments to the IMA knowledge base and has no AI model use.
